We are looking for a production worker with a good knowledge of English. Are you handy and able to work with a pneumatic nail gun?

This company, located in Lokeren, is a growing family business specializing in the production, repair, and recycling of wooden pallets. To strengthen their team, we are looking for a motivated pallet repairer. Do you enjoy hands-on, repetitive work, and do you not shy away from physical labor? Then you might be the colleague the company is looking for. 
Your tasks:
• Assembling and repairing wooden pallets according to our quality standards.
• Working with a pneumatic nail gun.
• Sorting pallets by type and quality.
• Keeping your workspace clean, organized, and safe.
• Collaborating with your colleagues to meet daily production targets.
 

What we ask of you:
• You enjoy working with tools and like manual labor.
• You are physically fit and willing to work at a steady pace.
• You work accurately and have an eye for quality.
• You can express yourself in English; having another native language is no problem (but English is a must).

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Do you enjoy working with your hands and already have experience working night shifts? Then this job could be perfect for you!As an assembler, you will help assemble electric seats for trucks. You will join a new night shift team and receive a short training period first.- You assemble different parts of truck seats.- You follow simple work instructions.- You check that everything is assembled correctly.You work a fixed night shift from 10:00 PM to 5:55 AM, from Sunday night to Friday morning.
- Vaardigheden:You are handy and enjoy working with your hands.You have experience working night shifts.You work accurately and are eager to learn.You are willing to work in a two-shift system for the first 1 to 2 weeks.- Attesten:Not applicable.- Opleidingsvereisten:A technical education is an advantage, but not a requirement.- Vakkennis:Following technical instructions, performing precise assembly work and carrying out quality checks. Experience working night shifts is required.- Talenkennis:You have a good command of either Dutch or English. Being proficient in just one of these languages is sufficient!

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery. You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do? • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium • You check deliveries and documents • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like? • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you? • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate) • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus • You are flexible and customer-oriented • You live in the Geel region • You perform physical work with a smile • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return? • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home • Working with clear structure and fixed routes • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates • Flexible mindset • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian • Living in the Geel region

Take the next step in your accounting career within an international real estate environment. An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Senior Accountant with a background in Property Management or Real Estate, looking to take on a hands-on and autonomous role within an international property group.

This position goes beyond traditional accounting responsibilities. You will play an important role in ensuring the continuity of daily accounting operations while bringing your expertise to the optimisation of existing processes and financial systems. Working directly with the Finance Manager and senior management, you will have the opportunity to challenge current practices, make recommendations and contribute to the development of a more efficient accounting environment.

This opportunity is particularly suited to an experienced accounting professional who combines strong technical knowledge with professional maturity, initiative and the ability to adapt to an evolving organisation.

As a Senior Accountant, you will:

• Take ownership of day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and compliance with internal procedures.
• Handle supplier invoices, customer billing, payment processing and general ledger entries.
• Monitor accounting transactions and ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial records.
• Manage accounting activities related to property operations, ensuring reliable financial information and appropriate follow-up.
• Work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and its associated accounting functionalities and systems.
• Review existing accounting processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability and reporting quality.
• Challenge established practices and make constructive recommendations to optimise accounting workflows.
• Work closely with the Finance Manager to ensure continuity across accounting activities and support the smooth running of the finance function.
• Contribute to process optimisation, system improvements and ongoing transformation initiatives.
• Support the development and implementation of improved accounting procedures and working methods.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient financial operations and effective communication.

About You : 

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field.
• You have approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant professional experience in accounting. More experienced candidates are also welcome.
• You have previous experience in Property Management, Real Estate, property development or a related environment. This is considered a strong advantage.
• You possess solid knowledge of general accounting operations, including supplier accounting, customer invoicing, payment processing and general ledger activities.
• You have experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365. Knowledge of similar ERP systems is also valuable.
• You communicate fluently in both French and English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
• You are highly autonomous and comfortable taking ownership of accounting responsibilities from day one.
• You demonstrate professional maturity and have the confidence to challenge existing processes, identify inefficiencies and make constructive recommendations.
• You are comfortable combining hands-on accounting responsibilities with process optimisation and change management initiatives.
• You are a quick learner who can adapt easily to new systems, procedures and organisational requirements.
• You demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the ability to maintain high standards of accuracy and quality.
• You are proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders.

Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a new challenge? As a Business Controller, you will contribute to the financial performance of an international industrial organisation in Brussels. Working closely with various departments and management teams, you will provide valuable financial insights, support strategic decisions and contribute to the continuous improvement of financial processes.

 

 

 

 

Your responsibilities as a Business Controller

• Oversee financial performance, analyse results and provide clear insights to management.
• Contribute to budgeting, forecasting and regular financial reporting activities.
• Monitor project costs, profitability and financial performance, ensuring accurate follow-up.
• Develop and improve reporting tools, dashboards and financial processes.
• Monitor key performance indicators and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Support financial audits, annual closing activities and investment assessments.
• Collaborate with operational departments and management on financial and business-related matters.
• Participate in the development and optimisation of financial systems and digital tools.

About you

• You hold a Master's degree in Finance, Economics or a related field.
• You have at least 5 years of experience in business controlling, preferably in an industrial environment.
• You have a solid understanding of financial analysis, cost accounting and Belgian GAAP.
• You have excellent Excel skills and practical experience with Power BI and Power Query.
• You are comfortable working with financial data, developing reports and improving processes.
• You have experience collaborating with international and cross-functional teams.
• You are fluent in French, Dutch and English.
• You are autonomous, proactive and capable of managing multiple priorities.
• Knowledge of SAP is an asset; experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Forklift Operator (m/f/x) Geel – Start Immediately in 2-Shift System in the Food Industry
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you will work in a modern warehouse in the food industry located in Geel. You play a key role in the efficient and safe handling of goods, working closely with your colleagues. You ensure all logistics processes run smoothly and that quality and safety are always guaranteed. You work in a two-shift system, giving you set working hours with plenty of variety in your day.

Your day starts by checking your workplace: cleanliness and hygiene are essential. Next, you receive goods, check delivery notes, and process deliveries accurately. You place pallets in the correct locations, load trucks properly, and carry out inventory management and stock counts. You use a hand scanner and strictly follow all food safety (HACCP) procedures. You are flexible and ready to help out wherever needed, so the team can always rely on one another.

Do you want to make an impact in a versatile logistics role and help build a safe food supply chain? Apply today and make the difference as a forklift operator in Geel!

• Valid forklift certificate

• Experience with inventory management and order picking using a hand scanner

• Knowledge of HACCP and food safety

• Good computer skills (WMS)

• Able to work independently and solve problems

• Accurate, reliable, and strong communication skills

• Flexible and available for two-shift work

• Minimum lower or upper secondary education

• English speaking skills

• Adaptable, quality-focused, and stress-resistant

Are you an experienced financial professional with an interest in technology, or an ICT specialist who enjoys working with budgets, forecasts and financial data? For a long-term assignment within a large and complex organisation, we are looking for an ICT Financial Analyst who can combine financial analysis with hands-on operational support.

 

You will join the ICT Finance team, which manages the end-to-end financial processes of the IT department. This includes budgeting, forecasting, monitoring actual costs, internal invoicing and capacity management.
Your responsibilities

In this role, you will:

• Document the ICT department's budgeting, forecasting and invoicing processes

• Monitor ICT invoices on a daily basis

• Support Service Delivery Managers in preparing their budgets and quarterly forecasts

• Perform financial analyses and translate the results into clear reports

• Prepare quarterly invoices for the different internal clients of the ICT department

• Monitor the capacity of the various ICT teams and assess whether it remains aligned with the available budget

• Calculate and monitor the costs of different infrastructure components

• Combine analytical and documentation work with operational financial tasks 

• You have at least five years of experience in ICT finance

• You have hands-on experience preparing and managing ICT budgets

• You have experience developing cost models

• You understand financial systems and processes related to budgeting, cost modelling and financial reporting

• You are comfortable analysing financial data and preparing accurate reports

• You have advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables

• Experience with capacity management or FinOps is a strong advantage

• Knowledge of a project management tool such as Jira is an asset

• You are willing to handle both strategic analyses and practical day-to-day financial activities 

Languages and soft skills

• You are fluent in French or Dutch and have at least a passive understanding of the other language

• A good command of English is considered an advantage

• You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• You enjoy working with numbers and have a critical and analytical mindset

• You can work independently while also contributing effectively within a team

• You are well organised and able to meet deadlines

Do you have strong technical skills and enjoy identifying and resolving mechanical, electrical and hydraulic faults? Are you passionate about machinery and looking for a varied role combining workshop activities with on-site service interventions? Then we have an exciting opportunity for you!
 

For a 
growing and technically specialised company active in the sales, rental and maintenance of construction machinery, we are looking for a 
Field Service Technician. You will be responsible for maintaining, repairing and optimising a wide range of machinery, including concrete pumps, screed machines, mortar machines and other specialised construction equipment.
 

You will join an experienced technical team within a company characterised by a flat organisational structure and a hands-on, no-nonsense approach. Thanks to the combination of workshop activities and on-site interventions, no two working days are the same. You will also receive a 
fully equipped service vehicle with tools and spare parts.
 

Your responsibilities
 
 

• You diagnose and resolve mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic faults on various types of construction machinery 

• You carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machinery powered by electric, diesel and petrol engines 

• You perform technical diagnostics and read and interpret electrical and hydraulic schematics, including 12-volt electrical systems 

• You are responsible for assembling, disassembling, repairing and replacing defective machine components 

• You perform functional tests, inspections and adjustments to ensure reliable machine operation 

• You assist with the installation and commissioning of new machinery at customer sites 

• You carry out technical service interventions at construction sites and other customer locations 

• You respond to customers' technical questions and provide telephone troubleshooting support whenever possible 

• You advise customers on the correct operation, maintenance and use of their machinery 

• You always work in accordance with applicable safety and quality standards  

In short: you are a versatile service technician who independently diagnoses and resolves technical problems, ensures reliable machine operation and provides customers with high-quality technical service.

We are looking for a solution-oriented technician with a passion for machinery, who enjoys working independently and takes responsibility for the quality of their work.
 
 

• You have 
at least some initial experience as a mechanic, maintenance technician or service technician 

• You have a good technical understanding of 
mechanics and electricity, complemented by knowledge of hydraulics, pneumatics and electronics 

• You are fluent in 
English 

• You can read and interpret electrical and hydraulic schematics 

• You hold a 
valid category B driving licence 

• You are flexible regarding travel distances and willing to undertake longer journeys when required 

• You are eager to learn and continuously develop your technical expertise  

In short: we are looking for a mechanic or service technician with broad technical knowledge, an independent working attitude and a strong interest in construction machinery and technical services.
